title: The first user's reading: each item at the lines of the work that give its Good, or, where you found none, what the receiver would need to get it, in one sentence.

items.description: one for each item of every checklist

good.description: an item whose Good you found, at the lines of the work that give it

checklist.description: the checklist's path, as you were given it

item.description: the item's ID, such as B-1

lines.description: the lines of the work that give its Good, each range as `<path>:<from>-<to>`; for an item asked of each part, at least one range in every part of the work, each inside one part

need.description: an item you found no Good for

checklist.description: the checklist's path, as you were given it

item.description: the item's ID, such as B-1

need.description: what the receiver would need to get from the work for its Good, in one sentence, not how to make it, such as "Before running `--undo`, the receiver can tell which folders come back."
